units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 98a">B. Kam. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>מחייה וטַרְשֵׁיה …</he> (Var. <he>טרסיה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300) he struck upon the coin with the hammer and battered it (so that the stamp was effaced).

<cite ref="Chullin 46b:3">Ḥull. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>בקרירי לא דמְטָרְשֵׁי</he> you must not put the lungs in cold water, because it makes the coat of the lungs brittle (so as to crack when you blow them up; [Ar. ed. Koh. <he>בחמימי לא דמט׳</he> not in hot water because ‘it makes strong’]; v. <cite ref="K00361"><he>כְּוַץ</he></cite>.
